turns.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
turns.text: Indeed, Your Majesty. The implications of your request are indeed serious. Please, proceed with your case.

turns.speaker: the King of Bohemia
turns.text: As you may have gathered, I am in a predicament that concerns a matter of grave personal and political import. My former fiancée, the Princess of Scandinavia, possesses a token that is of utmost significance to my family's honor and my own reputation.

turns.speaker: Dr. Watson
turns.text: I see, Your Majesty. May I ask what this token is and why it is so significant?

turns.speaker: the King of Bohemia
turns.text: This token is a locket containing a portrait of myself, which I gave to the Princess during our engagement. It is a symbol of my lineage and my royal status, and its return is imperative for my family's honor and my own standing as a monarch.

turns.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
turns.text: The token you describe, Your Majesty, is not merely a personal possession but a symbol of your royal lineage. I understand the gravity of its retrieval. Please elaborate on the circumstances of its loss.

turns.speaker: the King of Bohemia
turns.text: The situation is delicate. I parted ways with the Princess under contentious circumstances, and the locket was last known to be in her possession. I fear that, if it falls into the wrong hands, it could be used against me politically.

turns.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
turns.text: I understand the urgency of your request, Your Majesty. To proceed effectively, I need a detailed account of the last known interactions you had with the Princess and any individuals who might have been privy to the existence of this locket.

turns.speaker: Dr. Watson
turns.text: Holmes, the situation is indeed delicate. We must handle this with utmost discretion. Can you tell us more about the individuals involved and any potential threats to Your Majesty's security?

turns.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
turns.text: Dr. Watson is correct. We must approach this matter with the utmost caution. Your Majesty, I require a list of all individuals who were aware of the existence of the locket and any recent events that may have put it at risk.

turns.speaker: the King of Bohemia
turns.text: Indeed, I shall provide you with a list of those who knew about the locket. However, I must emphasize the utmost secrecy in our proceedings. Any breach could have dire consequences for my kingdom.

turns.speaker: Dr. Watson
turns.text: I understand the gravity of this situation, Your Majesty. Rest assured, Holmes and I will handle this matter with the utmost confidentiality.

turns.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
turns.text: Let us convene tomorrow at the same hour. I shall have conducted preliminary inquiries by then and will be in a better position to advise on the next steps.

turns.speaker: the King of Bohemia
turns.text: Very well, Holmes. I trust your discretion and expertise. I shall await your guidance tomorrow. Until then, I must retire to consider the security of my realm.

turns.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
turns.text: Good evening, Your Majesty. Dr. Watson and I will be here tomorrow at the appointed hour.

turns.speaker: the King of Bohemia
turns.text: I appreciate your understanding and professionalism, Dr. Watson. I shall ensure that my guards are vigilant tonight. Farewell, gentlemen.

turns.speaker: Dr. Watson
turns.text: Good evening, Your Majesty. I am confident that we will resolve this matter to your satisfaction.

turns.speaker: the King of Bohemia
turns.text: I shall ensure that no stone is left unturned. Until tomorrow, gentlemen.

turns.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
turns.text: Until then, Your Majesty. Ensure your safety is paramount.

turns.speaker: the King of Bohemia
turns.text: I trust in your expertise and shall proceed with caution. Until our meeting, gentlemen.

turns.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
turns.text: I shall expect you promptly at 11 a.m. tomorrow, Your Majesty.

opening.speaker: the King of Bohemia
opening.text: You had my note? I told you that I would call.

opening.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
opening.text: Pray take a seat. This is my friend and colleague, Dr. Watson, who is occasionally good enough to help me in my cases. Whom have I the honour to address?

opening.speaker: the King of Bohemia
opening.text: You may address me as the Count Von Kramm, a Bohemian nobleman. I understand that this gentleman, your friend, is a man of honour and discretion, whom I may trust with a matter of the most extreme importance. If not, I should much prefer to communicate with you alone.

opening.speaker: the King of Bohemia
opening.text: Then I must begin. I must bind you both to absolute secrecy for two years; at the end of that time the matter will be of no importance. At present it is not too much to say that it is of such weight it may have an influence upon European history.

opening.speaker: the King of Bohemia
opening.text: You will excuse this mask. The august person who employs me wishes his agent to be unknown to you, and I may confess at once that the title by which I have just called myself is not exactly my own.

opening.speaker: the King of Bohemia
opening.text: The circumstances are of great delicacy, and every precaution has to be taken to quench what might grow to be an immense scandal and seriously compromise one of the reigning families of Europe. To speak plainly, the matter implicates the great House of Ormstein, hereditary kings of Bohemia.

opening.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
opening.text: I was also aware of that.

opening.speaker: the King of Bohemia
opening.text: If your Majesty would condescend to state your case, I should be better able to advise you.

opening.speaker: the King of Bohemia
opening.text: You are right. I am the King. Why should I attempt to conceal it?
